title: Tenant-open read is allowed; the capability-gated external write executes only with grant plus argument-scope- and session-bound operator consent (userConsentRef on file)
note: Reads inside the tenant are open (an allow must NOT be manufactured by denying them). The external write is capability-gated: this fixture's principal holds the declared grant AND operator consent bound to the exact argument scope and session, so the escalated ask is downgraded to allow with a userConsentRef on file. Consent NEVER downgrades a deny, and grants are per-principal: the no-grant twin is P2b, where the same tool is denied outright even though this principal's consent exists.
